Source Monster

Monster: Bazelgeusling | CR: 10 | Tier: 2

Compatible Slots: Armor, Weapon

Weapon Effect

You gain a +1 bonus to your spell attack rolls and spell save DC while attuned to this weapon. This bonus increases to +2 when the spell you are casting deals fire damage.

Armor Effect

Guts. When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. Once you use this property, you can't use it again for 2 days.

Tags: mechanic:spell-buff:attack, mechanic:spell-buff:save, damage:fire, type:offensive
